scientific_integrity: The proof and exact witness are included; finite arithmetic verification supplements rather than replaces the Hilbert-space argument. No independent audit has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Bounded positive first operator, nonzero rank-one positive second operator and parameters strictly between zero and one; the crossover exponent is defined implicitly, and the comparator is the ordinary Heinz operator rather than the arithmetic sum.
title: Rank-one crossed-Heinz operators have a spectral-support Schatten crossover
